about: The story as days (brief records/briefs/2026-10-27__brief__the-story-as-days.md in team, the editor's decisions of 27 October). One file per calendar day in UTC, content/days/<date>.json; a day is closed by the desk at its first wake after midnight UTC. assets/design/days/days-live.js draws them: the front page (the last 24 hours, with the strip of days) and /on/<date>/.
